verdict.rationale: Attio documents a Workflows builder with event-based triggers, such as when a new deal record is created, and SDK custom triggers that subscribe to external events. Nothing in the evidence shows a time-based, recurring, or cron-style schedule for jobs or workflows. Event triggers and one-off actions are adjacent features, not recurring scheduling, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
